daily_schedule.details_and_significance: Early morning awakening seva of the Lord (Ticket: Rs. 116, single person).
Sacred morning bathing and archana rituals for the deity.
Early morning food offering to the deity.
Five sacred harathis and offering of sacred flowers with Vedic mantras.
Morning free general darshan slot for all devotees.
Continuous performance of the sacred Satyanarayana Swamy Vrathams across various halls (around 1 hour per batch).
Chanting of 108 and 1000 holy names of the Lord and Goddess.
Abhishekams performed by devotees in Yantralayam with ticket of Rs. 100/- each.
Daily celestial wedding ceremony of Lord Satyadeva and Goddess Anantha Lakshmi (Ticket: Rs. 1116).
Midday grand food offering; main darshan is paused briefly during this ritual.
Afternoon and evening general darshan for all pilgrims.
Afternoon repose seva for the Lord (Ticket: Rs. 50).
Evening court hall assembly for ticket holders (Ticket: Rs. 40/-).
Night court seva of the Lord.
Night closing ritual and resting seva of Goddess Ammavaru.
Temple sanctum remains closed until Suprabhata Seva.
